end.summary:
Practised identifying standing, sleeping and slanting straight lines.
Sorted straight and curved lines in examples such as V, bangles and football.
Found line types in letters H, A, T and L and in objects.
Teach-back was not passed; 8 of 10 line-identification attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised standing, sleeping and slanting lines through letters and familiar objects. Om explained the method using direction and shape, and correctly distinguished curved bangles and football edges from straight lines in V and goalposts. They briefly mixed up whether a corner in V might be curved, then corrected this later by identifying V as two straight slanting lines. At home, invite Om to spot and name these three line types in household objects or letters.
